executiveSummary: Today's AI picture is being shaped by frontier research, open-source stack, customer operations. The strongest signals point to a market where research progress, platform controls, and workflow execution are converging into more operational buying criteria.

The open-source layer is turning into a strategic option set for AI stack design, not only a hobbyist ecosystem.
Customer operations AI is shifting from note-taking to controlled action recommendation and orchestration.
